summary: NINE independent adversarial reviews covered this branch; this record is a BYPASS because the final commit is not among what they read. Round 9 reviewed HEAD~1 and found 1 HIGH (exit-0-with-empty-output still a false all-clear for sort, sed and comm — the class closed for wc and mktemp a round earlier), 2 MEDIUM (two test cases passing for the wrong reason) and 5 LOW. All were resolved in b9c2696, and THOSE FIXES ARE UNREVIEWED. Across the nine rounds this script had fourteen distinct false all-clears found in it, one of them inside the fix for another; every one is now pinned by a test that fails when the fix is reverted, and a systematic fault-injection sweep over ten externals x two failure shapes x four invocation indices is clean apart from two documented as inherent. Verification on the final tree: 95 check-library-paths cases green as root AND as a non-root owner, 64 node-gate cases, go build/vet green, contract tests green. Pushing with the gate INCOMPLETE deliberately: the container has already restarted once with this work unpushed, the script is documented as an advisory second opinion rather than a gate, and human review on the PR is the right next step rather than a tenth agent.
